amenities: Private plunge pool with sun loungers
Outdoor courtyard stone bath & shower
Bespoke organic bath amenities
24/7 dedicated guest relations service

rooms.description: Set amidst beautifully landscaped tropical gardens, the Deluxe Garden Villa offers an intimate retreat. Indulge in complete seclusion with a private plunge pool, and an outdoor courtyard featuring a magnificent hand-carved stone soaking tub and tropical rainfall shower. The interior displays refined organic wood features and plush custom linens.

rooms.name: Oceanfront Suite
amenities: Private balcony hot tub overlooking the ocean
Floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors
Personal dedicated private butler service
Espresso station & premium cocktail bar
Priority restaurant and spa reservations
rooms.description: Perched on the waters edge, our Oceanfront Suite delivers breathtaking cinematic vistas of the azure sea. Features floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass windows that slide completely open to integrate the private balcony with your master living space. Relax in your private balcony hot tub as the sun sinks beneath the horizon.

rooms.name: Presidential Penthouse
amenities: Vast panoramic private terrace with fire pit
Private infinity plunge pool
In-suite wellness therapy & massage room
Fully-stocked premium cocktail bar with private bartender
Complimentary luxury airport transfer & helicopter booking coordination
rooms.description: Exuding grandeur, the Presidential Penthouse represents the ultimate luxury stay. Boasting vast double-height vaulted ceilings, a beautifully curated lounge with a Steinway grand piano, a private butler pantry, and a fully stocked mixologist cocktail bar. The expansive private terrace features a heated plunge pool, luxury lounge cabanas, and an open-air fire pit overlooking the shoreline.

rooms.name: Sunset Lagoon Pavilion
amenities: Direct ladder entry to clear lagoon waters
Private overwater sunset hammock & deck pool
Underfloor glass panels for marine viewing
Bespoke in-room breakfast served by boat
Kayaks and snorkeling gear included
rooms.description: Elegantly built on stilts directly over the calm reef lagoon waters, the Sunset Lagoon Pavilion blends contemporary design with exotic wooden architectures. Step down from your private deck directly into the warm tropical waters or relax suspended over the lagoon in a handcrafted cotton hammock.

rooms.name: Wellness Spa Villa
amenities: Private massage room with on-call spa therapists
Volcanic stone soaking tub & private steam sauna
Complimentary daily in-villa spa treatments (90 min)
Custom aromatherapy diffuser selection
Curated wellness culinary dining menu
rooms.description: Designed specifically for rejuvenation, the Wellness Spa Villa features an private indoor therapy room. Enjoy daily complimentary spa treatments, a private organic steam sauna, and a deep volcanic stone bath surrounded by tranquil water features. Soft lighting, bamboo accents, and gentle water murmurs create a sublime zen state.

rooms.name: Royal Overwater Bungalow
amenities: Large glass floor viewing panels in living room
Expansive deck with private infinity pool
Direct stair access to the marine reef
24/7 private butler & chef service
Complimentary premium champagne on arrival
rooms.description: Our grandest overwater retreat, the Royal Overwater Bungalow features expansive glass floor viewing panels, bringing the vibrant ocean life directly into your living room. The spacious deck houses a private infinity pool, direct lagoon stairs, and a luxurious outdoor dining pavilion perfect for starlight dinners.
